Subject: Request: Priority Accelerator Stack + Tailored Overage & Reservation Hold for HelixHealth

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this in. Quick background: HelixHealth is ramping a real-time inference pipeline for clinical diagnostics and we have a go-live target in Q4. Our current Dedicated commit (9 x H200) will not meet latency for the new model stack. Procurement asked if Redwood can: 1) allow a temporary priority mix that includes up to 4 H100 equivalents in the same reservation (we'll return to H200-only after 90 days), 2) place a 14-day reservation hold while we finalize infrastructure changes, and 3) cap overage rates for any burst above the committed baseline (we request a 30% discount vs list overage for the first 90 days).

I've attached (helix_mrp_usage_q2.xlsx, helix_capacity_plan.pdf) for context — usage shape is spiky during validation windows. We can sign an amendment and accept a one-time provisioning fee if needed.

Request: can you escalate for an executive approval on non-standard GPU mix + temporary overage cap + reservation hold? Our procurement deadline is EOD 2026-09-09 to submit the signed amendment.

Thanks —
Anna Chen

HelixHealth

They are willing to sign an amendment and pay a one-time provisioning fee.

Why this matters: Helix is a strategic mid-market customer with a high likelihood of expanding committed capacity next year if this migration is smooth. The risk is setting a precedent for GPU-mix concessions and non-standard overage caps.

Can Deal Desk provide:
- karthik: quick cost delta for allowing 4 H100 equivalents in the reservation (estimate $/hour delta and projected 90-day overage exposure)
- lauren: recommendation on the reservation hold (14 days) and whether to accept as a temporary exception

Kim —

Quick numbers after an initial model: allowing 4 H100 equivalents in the reserved pool (temporary 90-day mix) increases the monthly unit cost delta by ~18% on the committed baseline. If Helix bursts beyond commit, capping overage to 30% off list for 90 days exposes us to an incremental estimated gross margin impact of ~$38k over the period given their Q2 spike pattern (see attached sample calc).

Options I recommend:
1) Approve a timeboxed H100 substitution for 90 days, but require a higher provisioning fee upfront to offset immediate hardware allocation costs (recommend one-time fee = $12,500).
2) Reservation hold: approve up to 14 days but require notification if hold extends beyond 7 days; after 7 days we start a rolling capacity allocation evaluation.
3) Overage cap: approve 30% off list for 90 days conditional on a signed amendment plus a clause that automatically reverts to standard overage pricing if Helix increases commit within 60 days.

If leadership is comfortable, please route to Vivek for final signoff on the provisioning fee and the conditional overage cap.

Karthik
Senior Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Priority Accelerator Stack + Tailored Overage & Reservation Hold for HelixHealth

Team —

After reviewing the ask and Karthik's delta, I authorize a one-time exception with the following binding terms:

1) Hardware mix: allow up to 4 H100 equivalents within HelixHealth's Dedicated reservation for a period of 90 days starting on the amendment effective date. This is timeboxed; no extension without separate executive approval.

2) Reservation hold: approve a 14-day hold window. If the customer requires more than 7 days, they must provide a written justification; we reserve the right to re-evaluate capacity allocation.

3) Overage pricing: cap overage at 30% off list for the first 90 days. This concession is conditional on (a) a signed amendment executed via DocuSign within 48 hours of this approval notice, and (b) a one-time provisioning fee of $12,500 to be invoiced upfront. If Helix increases committed capacity within 60 days, standard overage pricing will apply going forward and any rebates will be reconciled.

4) Compliance & audit: Deal Desk must record the amendment ID and update the customer's reservation metadata in our internal system. Legal to add a clause that prevents replicate concession language to other accounts without explicit Exec signoff.

Lauren / Karthik: please prepare the amendment (use the linked HubSpot deal record) and circulate DocuSign. Marissa: notify the account team and coordinate the signature window.

Vivek
